rule: A payload is assembled ONLY from these layers plus the per-shot facts the shot planner writes. Nothing is pasted by hand. Every assembled payload gets a prompt receipt (sha256 + template_version + section char map); kie_dispatch refuses a paid job whose prompt has no matching receipt (PROMPT_NOT_TEMPLATED).

caps._source_rule: Runtime reads 67-kie-video/models.json and 68-kie-audio/models.json first; this table only fills what the catalogs lack and is the fallback. A cap marked UNVERIFIED guards at that number and prints its status in the receipt.

quality_rules.h3_bracket_rule: Square brackets are reserved for camera commands in H3 prompts. Exactly one bracket group, 1-3 moves inside it. Section lead-ins are plain words with a colon.

cross_prompt_repeat.note: check_run(prompts): across one run's H3 prompts, no 8-word run may appear in more than this share of them. Shared lock blocks (look, identity, place, negatives) are exempt because they are copied whole by design; the check compares only the shot's own sections.

quality_rules.identity_cap_note: H3_IDENTITY_OVER_CAP: the continuity/identity section never exceeds this many chars. A bloated identity block crowds out the action and re-describes the face the reference picture already carries.

banned_style_words.note: N-35 / 3B.3: the validator refuses STYLE_WORD_BANNED outside the locked block. A mode file's own banned_words list, when present (U-LOOK), replaces the category list. Case-insensitive substring match.

picture_prompt_band.note: N-77 / 3H.2: under the floor refuses PICTURE_PROMPT_BELOW_FLOOR naming the thin shot fields; over the cap trims the shot's own part, background first and action last, and never trims a lock block. The builder never pads.
